M=np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in R.strip().split("\n")]); I={c:i for i,c in enumerate(B)}
def sc(a,b): return M[I.get(a,22),I.get(b,22)]
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    Tm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);Tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);Ty=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);Mx[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);Tx[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);Ty[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1])
            o=(Mx[i-1,j-1]+s,Ix[i-1,j-1]+s,Iy[i-1,j-1]+s);k=int(np.argmax(o));Mx[i,j]=o[k];Tm[i,j]=k
            o=(Mx[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(o));Ix[i,j]=o[k];Tx[i,j]=0 if k==0 else 1
            o=(Mx[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k=int(np.argmax(o));Iy[i,j]=o[k];Ty[i,j]=0 if k==0 else 2
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0 and i>0 and j>0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=Tm[i,j];i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1 and i>0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append("-");st=Tx[i,j];i-=1
        elif st==2 and j>0: a1.append("-");a2.append(s2[j-1]);st=Ty[i,j];j-=1
        elif i>0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append("-");i-=1
        else: a1.append("-");a2.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))

ORTH={"B9D1 human":"Q9UPM9","B9D1 mouse":"Q9R1S0","B9D1 zebrafish":"Q503B7",
      "B9D1 X.tropicalis":"Q5BJ61","B9D1 Drosophila":"Q9VF59","B9D1 Chlamydomonas":"A8J3B5"}
def seq(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:])
ref=seq("Q21191"); hits=np.zeros(len(ref)); n=0; ok=[]
for nm,a in ORTH.items():
    s=seq(a)
    if len(s)<50: print("skip",nm,a,len(s)); continue
    a1,a2=nw(ref,s); ri=0; n+=1; ok.append(nm)
    for x,y in zip(a1,a2):
        if x!="-":
            ri+=1
            if x==y: hits[ri-1]+=1
cons=hits/n
dom=[i for i in range(7,204)]
ap=np.array([cons[i-1] for i in dom if i in APEX]); re_=np.array([cons[i-1] for i in dom if i not in APEX])
u,p=mannwhitneyu(ap,re_,alternative="two-sided")
print("orthologs used:",n,ok)
print(f"mean identity to MKSR-1, CBR-equivalent apex (n={len(ap)}): {ap.mean():.3f}")
print(f"mean identity to MKSR-1, rest of B9 domain (n={len(re_)}): {re_.mean():.3f}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U={u:.0f}, p={p:.3g}, rank-biserial r={2*u/(len(ap)*len(re_))-1:+.3f}")
print("apex residues identical in 6/6 orthologs:",[f"{ref[i-1]}{i}" for i in APEX if cons[i-1]==1.0])
print("apex residues identical in >=5/6:",[f"{ref[i-1]}{i}" for i in APEX if cons[i-1]>=5/6])
print("whole-domain mean identity:",f"{np.mean([cons[i-1] for i in dom]):.3f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.4))
x=np.arange(1,len(ref)+1)
ax.bar(x,cons,color=["#c0532a" if i in APEX else "#9fb6c9" for i in x],width=1.0)
ax.set_xlim(0,len(ref)+1); ax.set_ylim(0,1.12)
ax.set_xlabel("MKSR-1 residue number"); ax.set_ylabel("fraction identical\n(6 B9D1 orthologs)")
ax.set_title("Conservation along MKSR-1. Orange: residues structurally equivalent to the C2 calcium-loop apex",fontsize=10)
for i in [23,25,87,89,95]:

ax.axhline(np.mean([cons[i-1] for i in dom]),ls="--",lw=0.8,color="k")
ax.text(len(ref),np.mean([cons[i-1] for i in dom])+0.02,"domain mean",ha="right",fontsize=8)
